name: kept-children
title: useKeptChildren
description: Children that survive a change of presentation: rendered once through a portal into a detached element that the current home docks, so a draft, the caret, scroll and a streaming reply stay mounted while a region moves between a column, a drawer, a pushed page or a floating sheet. The kit's one way to keep children mounted (AdaptivePane, Sidebar, ArtifactChatContainer).
